summary: Allurion Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting a 1-for-15 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective June 18, 2026, on the OTCQB Market. The reverse split was approved by stockholders at the December 18, 2025 annual meeting and by the Board's Pricing Committee. No fractional shares will be issued; cash-in-lieu will be paid. The temporary trading symbol is ALURD for 20 business days, reverting to ALUR. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
